content.text: A pregnancy that ends before 20wks gestation
*threatened is the only one that is potentially viable
•maternal factors include STIs, antiphospholipid syndrome, trauma, Rh isoimmunization, malnutrition, anatomic abnormalities
*all women who are Rh (-) should also receive anti-D Rh immunoglobulin at this time for all abortions
, bed rest, & close follow up to see if sxs either resolve or progress to abortion
•serial beta-hCG to see if doubling to see if viable
: allow POC to fully pass w/ serial beta-hCG & transvaginal U/S to determine when complete
abnormal karyotyping found in 50% of SAB
MC aneuploidy is monosomy x/Turner’s syndrome
- not a typical cause of recurrence
•Hyperprolactinemia, poorly controlled DM, luteal phase defect, untreated hypothyroidism
•Cervical insufficiency - cerclage between 11-13 weeks leads to successful pregnancy in up to 90% of women
- location is more important than size
(leads to dilation & softening of the cervix & placental separation)
(causes uterine contractions) – pt must return 7-14d after mifepristone to confirm complete termination of pregnancy
followed by misoprostol 3-7d later (safe up to 7wks)
: can be performed up to 24wks from LMP
: includes usage of a curette or suction curettage (manual or electric vacuum aspiration) – used during first 4-12wks
